name: electric-game-builder-connector
description: Install trampoline for the real package in server/ — lets `npm install github:jdonnell96/electric-game-builder-connector` work from the repo root, since npm's git-dependency resolution looks for package.json there, not in a subdirectory. server/dist and server/addon are committed (not built at install time — a git-dependency install does not run this reliably enough to depend on, see git history) so a fresh install has everything it needs immediately. These dependencies are a duplicate of server/package.json's own runtime (not dev) dependencies, declared here too so a plain `npm install` of this package actually pulls them into the consumer's node_modules — server/ is a plain subdirectory, not an npm workspace member, so its own package.json dependencies are otherwise invisible to npm's resolution of this one.
